rules.source: captures of the 570 games whose examples/registry.json claim status is "done" (1926 images); games still being watched were never touched
rules.assetType: (colour, variant); variants: settlement, city, road, metropolis science/politics/trade, knight level 1-3 active/inactive
rules.rule1: an asset type present in 10 or fewer images is RARE; every image containing a rare asset type is kept, no exceptions
rules.rule2: greedy weighted set cover fills the rest to at least 5 kept images per asset type; game diversity comes first (an image from a game not yet represented for that asset type beats another frame of a game that already contributes one, which is only used when no other game has the asset), then more still-uncovered types, then more pieces of the asset
rules.rule3: images that are unclassified (reading ok:false, or a "knight (no close match)" / "metropolis ?" piece) and carry no rare asset were left in examples/games and are never moved, corner cases included
rules.rule4: at most 10 kept images per asset type is a preference only; rule 1 overrides it
rules.cornerCases: up to 3 images per (colour, variant, case), preferring games not yet used for that bucket and images not already in the main set. An image already in the main set keeps its main path and is never moved twice; a newly moved one lives under corner-cases/<the rarest case it was picked for>/<game>/<file> and is referenced from every case entry that picked it.
rules.labels: "<colour> knight (no close match)" and "<colour> metropolis ?" are unclassified-piece labels, not asset types; they appear in each image's assets but never count towards coverage
rules.layout: examples/kept/<game>/<file> is the main coverage set, examples/kept/corner-cases/<case>/<game>/<file> the corner-case set; collection/src/variants.ts scans both

cornerCases.name: board-edge
cornerCases.rule: A settlement, city, metropolis or knight standing on an outer-corner vertex of the lattice - a vertex that belongs to exactly one tile (18 of the 54), so the sprite is drawn half over the sea and the shore tile art instead of over land.

cornerCases.name: shore-road
cornerCases.rule: A road on a shore edge - an edge that borders exactly one tile (30 of the 72), so the road runs along the coastline with sea and harbour art behind it.

cornerCases.name: metropolis-tower-overlap
cornerCases.rule: A piece whose drawn sprite rectangle overlaps another board piece's by more than 2% of a building sprite's area. Measured with the real draw geometry (buildings 154 px at spacing/416*1.2 anchored -0.065*spacing, knights 0.35*spacing, the metropolis tower offset 0.28*154*pieceScale to the right). In this dataset the only pairing that reaches the threshold is a metropolis tower covering the knight on the neighbouring vertex, so both the covered knight and the covering metropolis are flagged.
